name: Lost Memory Desperate
source:
They say that somewhere in a dark forest, inside an abandoned bus, there lives a creature. A mistake the world itself carries within it, for it devours a person’s very existence — as though they had never existed at all. Erasing every trace of their being from reality itself.
And yet, some people seek it out willingly. Desperate souls searching for salvation in the void.
translation:
他们说，在黑暗森林的某个地方，一辆废弃的巴士内，住着一种生物。这是世界本身的错误，因为它吞噬了一个人的存在——就好像他们根本不存在一样。从现实本身中抹去他们存在的每一个痕迹。
然而，有些人却心甘情愿地寻求它。绝望的灵魂在虚空中寻找救赎。
